record.label: Spacetime cost of the momentum-space QSP baseline
record.description: Appendix G.2 evaluates Rubin et al.'s Eq. (12) at $\varepsilon=10^{-2}$ with $\lambda=1{,}744{,}784.42$ Ha from Table 2. Summing 50 runs at each of the ten times gives about $4.80\times10^9$ walk steps. At $C_{\mathrm{BE}}=2.498\times10^4$ Toffolis per walk step and four $T$ gates per Toffoli, the average is $9.59\times10^{11}$ $T$ gates per run. Multiplying by $Q_{\mathrm{base}}=5{,}650$ logical qubits gives a spacetime cost of $5.42\times10^{15}$ per run.
